title: VPC Endpoints
explanation: VPC endpoints enable private connections between your VPC and supported AWS services without requiring an internet gateway, NAT device, VPN, or Direct Connect. There are two types: interface endpoints and gateway endpoints.
analogy: VPC endpoints are like internal mail slots — you can send packages to AWS services through a private slot in your wall without going outside to the mailbox.
keyPoints: Gateway endpoints: free, support S3 and DynamoDB only, use route table entries
Interface endpoints: use PrivateLink, create ENIs in your subnet, support 100+ services
Traffic never leaves the AWS network
Endpoint policies control which resources can be accessed

examKeywords.definition: A private connection between a VPC and AWS services that does not require internet access. Gateway type (S3/DynamoDB) or Interface type (PrivateLink).

commonMistakes: Using a NAT Gateway to access S3 when a free Gateway endpoint would suffice
Confusing gateway endpoints (route table based, free) with interface endpoints (ENI based, charged)
